# FaultLab Vision

## Mission

Break your app before your users do.

FaultLab is a browser-based failure injection platform for web applications.

The goal is to help frontend developers, QA engineers and full-stack teams discover resilience issues before production.

Instead of mocking APIs during development, FaultLab introduces controlled failures into a running application.

The question FaultLab answers is:

"What happens when the world stops being perfect?"

## Primary Users

- Frontend Developers
- QA Engineers
- Full-Stack Developers
- Product Teams
- Test Engineers

## Long-Term Goal

Become the standard chaos engineering platform for web applications.

Browser Chaos, UI Chaos, Auto Chaos, reports, integrations, CLI, and team workflows are long-term vision,
not current capabilities. The current product is the local FaultLab browser extension focused on network
failure injection, JSON response mutation, scenario configuration, recording, and issue collection.
